tools.name: analyze_discovery_readiness
tools.title: Analyze AI Discovery Readiness
tools.description: Score caller-supplied website and business discovery signals. This tool does not fetch the website, run an AI scan, persist data, or verify inclusion in any AI product.

businessName.description: The business name used only to label this assessment.

websiteUrl.description: Optional page URL used only as a label. The tool will not fetch this URL.

status.description: Observed status. Use unknown when the caller has no evidence.

evidence.description: Concise caller-supplied evidence supporting the stated status.

signals.description: Caller-supplied signal observations. Omitted signals are treated as unknown.

tools.name: build_visibility_action_plan
tools.title: Build an AI Visibility Action Plan
tools.description: Prioritize fixes from caller-supplied findings using a deterministic rubric. This tool does not edit a website, contact third parties, persist data, or promise rankings or mentions.

goal.description: The outcome used to break ties in the deterministic priority rubric.

effortBudget.description: Controls how many actions are returned and how they are phased.

status.description: Observed status. Use unknown when the caller has no evidence.

evidence.description: Concise caller-supplied evidence supporting the stated status.

findings.description: Caller-supplied findings. Present findings are acknowledged but do not create actions.

annotations.title: Build an AI Visibility Action Plan

tools.name: summarize_scan_evidence
tools.title: Summarize AI Scan Evidence
tools.description: Calculate mention and business-citation rates from caller-supplied captures. This tool does not call AI providers, fetch URLs, persist data, or establish current inclusion beyond the supplied observations.

sourceLabel.description: Caller-supplied label for the model, product, or source.

surfaceType.description: How the caller obtained this capture.

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the supplied capture.

businessCitationUrls.description: URLs that the caller identified as citations specifically for the named business.

sourceLabel.description: Caller-supplied label for the model, product, or source.

surfaceType.description: How the caller obtained this capture.

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the supplied capture.

observations.description: Point-in-time captures supplied by the caller. The tool will not obtain new captures.

tools.name: list_monitored_businesses
tools.title: Find your MentionedOn businesses
tools.description: List businesses owned by your connected MentionedOn account and their monitoring/setup status. Start here when the user asks how their business appears in AI answers. Returns a setup link for an empty account. No scan, subscription or charge is started.

tools.name: get_visibility_report
tools.title: See visibility evidence and changes
tools.description: Read a business's latest saved AI capture, competitors, source links and up to 30 prior snapshots. Compare scores only when saved model, prompt and capture recipes match and both captures are complete. Reports provider gaps and timestamps. This does not query models or establish current consumer-app inclusion.

tools.name: get_website_fixes
tools.title: Read saved website fixes
tools.description: Read the current revision, source observations, confirmed facts, proposed schema/copy and installation checks for an owned business. No website is fetched or changed.

tools.name: inspect_business_website
tools.title: Inspect your business website
tools.description: Fetch the saved business website with bounded public HTML requests and save candidate facts with source receipts. Requires a paid or trial monitoring slot and explicit authorization. Pass the exact current revision. Existing draft content is preserved: start a new inspection only before confirming facts. Does not run AI scans or publish anything.

revision.description: Exact saved revision returned by get_website_fixes; use 0 when no record exists.

tools.name: draft_website_fixes
tools.title: Prepare confirmed website fixes
tools.description: Generate and save reviewable business schema, website copy and a business-profile description from facts the user explicitly confirms. Inspect first, preserve the exact revision, and never invent missing business facts. No model spend, external publication or messages.

revision.description: Exact saved revision returned by get_website_fixes; use 0 when no record exists.

tools.name: verify_website_fixes
tools.title: Verify installed website fixes
tools.description: Compare saved, reviewed schema and text against a page on the same owned business website. Save dated found/not-found/unknown checks against the exact artifact revision. Requires authorization and an entitled monitoring slot. Installation checks do not prove a visibility improvement.
